episodes.title: Death
episodes.summary: After enduring seven years of relentless job hunting and daily struggle, Yee-jae finally decides to end his own life. After death, he encounters a mysterious entity.

episodes.title: The Reason You're Going to Hell
episodes.summary: Yee-jae doesn't understand why he's being punished and protests as he continues to face Death's retribution.

episodes.title: Death Can't Take Anything Away
episodes.summary: As he continues to undergo Death's unpredictable trials, Yee-jae decides to take steps to prepare for his next life, unbeknownst to Death.

episodes.title: The Reason You're Afraid of Death
episodes.summary: Death mocks humans, asserting that they desperately struggle to live only after they have died. In this life, Yee-jae reunites with someone he's missed dearly.

episodes.title: It Is Impossible to Break Free and Fight against Death
episodes.summary: Death warns that it will intervene if Yee-jae ever attempts to kill someone, but Yee-jae dismisses the warning as he prepares his revenge.

episodes.title: Memory
episodes.summary: Yee-jae plans to accomplish what the world has failed to do, while Tae-u begins his counterattack.

episodes.title: Opportunity
episodes.summary: Yee-jae realizes that no matter how many times he's reborn, it's meaningless if he doesn't live as himself.

episodes.title: Don't Go Looking For Death. Death Will Come Find You.
episodes.summary: Just one final bullet remains. Will Yee-jae be able to evade death and survive?
